title: Rush-Order Amounts on Concert Attire by Days before the Next Concert, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Rush-order amount.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a rush-order amount is added to the concert attire package total of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** by the calendar days from the packet's received date to the first of the ensemble's concerts on 2026-12-10, 2027-02-11 and 2027-05-13 that falls on or after that date: with fewer than 14 days it is 10.00 plus 2.00 for each day short of 14; with 14 days or more but fewer than 28 days it is 8.00; and otherwise, or when no concert falls on or after that date, nothing.

**The packet's received date.** The packet's received date is the latest received date among the documents received on the participation's records log: a packet counts as received when its last form arrives.

| Days from the packet's received date to the next concert | Rush-order amount |
|---|---|
| 0 to 13 | 10.00 plus 2.00 for each day short of 14 |
| 14 to 27 | 8.00 |
| 28 or more | nothing |
| no concert on or after the received date | nothing |

## Cases before the concert of 2026-12-10 (hypothetical received dates)

| Received date | Days | Days short of 14 | Rush-order amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-12-03 | 7 | 7 | 10.00 plus 14.00, 24.00 |
| 2026-11-27 | 13 | 1 | 10.00 plus 2.00, 12.00 |
| 2026-11-26 | 14 | none | 8.00 |
| 2026-11-13 | 27 | none | 8.00 |
| 2026-11-12 | 28 | none | nothing |

A packet received on a concert day counts 0 days, 14 days short: 10.00 plus 28.00, 38.00.
